title: ASP Skill Manifest
description: JSON Schema for the AI Skill Protocol (ASP) skill manifest (skill.yaml). This schema is the normative specification for what constitutes a valid skill manifest.

semver.description: A valid Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 version string.

semver_range.description: A semver version range constraint. Supports: >=, <=, >, <, ==, !=, ^ (caret), ~ (tilde), * (wildcard), and comma-separated AND constraints.

skill_id.description: Globally unique skill identifier in reverse-domain notation. Lowercase letters, digits, dots, and hyphens. Example: io.github.username.my-skill

skill_name.description: Short, lowercase, hyphen-separated skill name. Used in CLI commands and display.

input_name.description: Input/output parameter name. Lowercase letters, digits, and underscores.

capability.description: An AI model capability identifier. Vendor-neutral.

name.description: Author's full name or organization name.

url.description: URL to author's profile or organization homepage.

input_output.description: A typed input or output parameter definition.

name.description: Parameter name. Must be unique within inputs or outputs.

type.description: JSON Schema primitive type for this parameter.

required.description: Whether this parameter is required. Defaults to true.

default.description: Default value when parameter is not provided. Only meaningful when required is false.

enum.description: Restricts the parameter to one of these values.

minLength.description: Minimum string length. Only valid when type is 'string'.

maxLength.description: Maximum string length. Only valid when type is 'string'.

dependency.description: A dependency on another ASP skill.

id.description: The skill ID of the dependency.

version.description: Version range constraint for the dependency.

optional.description: Whether this dependency is optional. If true, the skill can run without it but may have reduced functionality.

tool.description: An external tool or MCP server that this skill may invoke.

required.description: Whether this tool is required for the skill to function.

example.description: A sample input/output pair demonstrating skill usage.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this example demonstrates.

input.description: Input parameter values for this example.

expected_output_contains.description: Strings that the output should contain. Used for smoke testing.

evaluation_case.description: A test case for evaluating skill quality.

description.description: What behavior this test case validates.

input.description: Input values for this test case.

assert_contains.description: Strings that the output MUST contain for this test to pass.

assert_not_contains.description: Strings that the output MUST NOT contain for this test to pass.

asp.description: ASP protocol version this manifest targets. MUST be '1.0' for ASP 1.0 manifests.

id.description: Globally unique skill identifier in reverse-domain notation. Choose a domain you control or use io.github.{username}.{skill-name}.

name.description: Short skill name used in CLI commands and display. Lowercase, hyphen-separated.

version.description: Skill version following Semantic Versioning 2.0.0. Increment major for breaking changes, minor for new features, patch for bug fixes.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this skill does. Should be clear enough for a developer to understand without reading the instructions.

instructions.description: The LLM instructions defining this skill's behavior. This is the core of the skill — the system prompt or user prompt template that will be injected into the AI runtime. May reference input parameters by name.

license.description: SPDX license identifier. See https://spdx.org/licenses/. Examples: MIT, Apache-2.0, GPL-3.0-only.

homepage.description: URL to the skill's homepage or documentation.

repository.description: URL to the skill's source code repository.

inputs.description: Typed input parameters this skill accepts. Define all parameters the instructions reference.

outputs.description: Typed output values this skill produces. Helps consumers understand the structure of the response.

capabilities.description: AI model capability requirements. Use capability names rather than vendor names for maximum portability.

required.description: Capabilities the model MUST have for this skill to function correctly.

optional.description: Capabilities that enhance the skill but are not required.

unsupported.description: Model names or identifiers known to be incompatible with this skill.

dependencies.description: Other ASP skills this skill depends on. Dependencies are resolved and installed automatically.

tools.description: External tools or MCP servers this skill may invoke. Helps runtimes pre-configure the tool environment.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum execution time in seconds. Runtimes SHOULD enforce this.

max_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens to request from the model.

examples.description: Sample inputs with expected outputs. Used for documentation and basic smoke testing.

evaluation.description: Quality assurance test cases for this skill.

cases.description: Test cases. Each case specifies inputs and assertions on the output.

permissions.description: Runtime permissions this skill requires. Clients MUST display non-default permissions to users before execution.

network.description: Whether this skill requires network/HTTP access.

filesystem.description: Whether this skill requires reading or writing local files.

code_execution.description: Whether this skill requires executing code in a sandbox.

tool_use.description: Whether this skill requires calling external tools or MCP servers.

metadata.description: Additional metadata for discoverability and compatibility.

tags.description: Searchable tags. Lowercase, max 30 characters each.

created_at.description: Date the skill was first created (ISO 8601 date).

asp_compatible.description: Range of ASP protocol versions this skill is compatible with.

^x-.description: Extension field. Any field prefixed with 'x-' is an extension and must be preserved by conforming implementations.

examples.name: code-review
examples.description: Reviews source code for bugs, security vulnerabilities, and style issues.
examples.instructions: You are an expert code reviewer. Analyze the provided code for bugs, security issues, and style problems.
